reader_summary.overview: I have personally interviewed Paxos's CEO, Chad Kaskarilla, on this podcast before, and I'm excited about how they're changing the crypto landscape. Whether you're a small fintech or a large financial institution, with Paxos crypto brokerage, you can offer your customers crypto buying, selling, transferring, and more. Paxos takes care of everything in the back end from licensing and compliance to come.

thesis: The speaker argues that the financial system's back office and post-trade operations remain inefficient because they still rely on outdated cobalt mainframes from the 1970s and 1980s. He contends that blockchain technology offers a solution by enabling a decentralized system that is more resilient, open, accessible, cheaper, and capable of freeing up capital.
